UTC calendar month of outage start. Credits are recoverable by Customer and are not Customer liabilities.

window at least 48 hours before its start and the outage was wholly inside that window. Provider scheduling
alone is not approval. If approval evidence is missing, applicability is unresolved pending evidence; do not
presume approval or its absence.

claims@forge.example. A valid claim is due by 17:00 UTC on the tenth following calendar date. Credits are
the sole monetary remedy for service unavailability under this agreement; no downstream damages are
reimbursed.
6 INCIDENT EVIDENCE

6.1 Provider restoration logs identify incident ID, service ID, start, end and any scheduled window. A later
signed approval record may supply earlier approval evidence. A repeated log for the same incident is not a
second outage. Corrected records supersede the identified prior record without creating another incident.
7 NOTICE AND CURE

7.1 For a material breach other than service unavailability, written notice must be received at
legal@forge.example. Provider has 10 calendar days after receipt to cure, ending at 17:00 UTC on the tenth
following date. Customer may serve a separate termination notice only after that deadline if the breach
remains uncured.

8.1 Indian law governs this agreement. Courts in Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes under
this agreement. This provision neither chooses the forum for other contracts nor promises consolidated
proceedings.

9.1 All times are UTC and all days are calendar days. There is no weekend or holiday adjustment. A deadline
stated as a date ends at 17:00 UTC unless another time is explicit. Financial amounts exclude taxes, which
are outside this agreement. No terms from an absent document may be assumed.
10 HOSTING ACCEPTANCE

10.1 Mira Sen for Aurora and Anil Das for Forge record execution on 2026-12-15.
11 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

11.1 The monthly service-credit cap in clause 3.1 is INR 20,000. For other claims, each party aggregate
liability is capped at INR 1,000,000, except fraud, wilful misconduct and indemnity obligations. Downstream
service liabilities are not reimbursed under this agreement.
12 HOSTING CLAIM DEFENCE

12.1 A party whose supplied hosting materials infringe third-party intellectual property, or whose unauthorized
disclosure produces a third-party claim, shall indemnify the other for that claim and reasonable defense costs.
The protected party must give prompt notice and cooperate in the defense.
13 HOSTING INFORMATION

13.1 Hosting configurations, access keys and the other party commercial information shall be disclosed only
to personnel who need them for this hosting service and owe confidentiality duties. Use for another purpose is
prohibited. Protection continues for 3 years after termination, except for information public without breach.
C01 | Cloud Services Agreement Page 2
FORGE ELECTRONICS / C01
14 OPERATING REQUIREMENTS

14.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in hosting facilities. This includes the Digital
Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where its processing scope applies.
Personal-data processing requires access controls and a documented incident-response procedure. No ISO
certification is promised.
15 HOSTING TRANSFER

15.1 Transfer of the hosting agreement needs the other party written consent. An affiliate transfer is permitted
on 30 calendar days written notice only if the original party remains liable. A change of control does not
substitute a new party or waive required consent.
16 EXCEPTIONAL HOSTING DISRUPTION

16.1 Relief for an event beyond reasonable control is confined to the affected obligations in hosting facilities.
The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after discovery, explain causation and
provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable. Neither an outage nor supplier delay
qualifies automatically.
17 ALTERNATIVE HOSTS

17.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of hosting facilities. This
agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly stated in this clause.
18 ORDINARY HOSTING EXIT

18.1 Either party may end future hosting facilities for convenience by written notice received at the other party
legal notice address at least 30 calendar days before termination. Accrued payment obligations, express
survival provisions and the stated conditions of any early-exit fee continue to apply.

1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01) and Willow Housing Private Limited (P03), also parties to
customer supply agreement C04 and lease C05, enter PROJECT-HABITAT for a smart-building
deployment pilot. This agreement concerns deployment coordination and the separate surplus-controller
procurement in clause 3.1. It does not replace C04, C05 or any APP-ATLAS obligation under C02.
Company legal notice address: aurora-legal@aurora.example. Counterparty legal notice address:
legal@willow.example.
2 DATES AND EFFECT

2.1 Signed on 2027-01-20; effective from 2027-02-01 at 00:00 UTC through 2027-05-31 inclusive, with
no automatic renewal. No obligations under this agreement accrue before its effective date. Ingestion or
upload does not change that date.
3 ADDITIONAL CONTROLLER PROCUREMENT

3.1 Willow has surplus unopened AX-7 controllers from a completed housing installation. Aurora
commits to purchase 100 AX-7 controllers from Willow for delivery on 2027-02-20 at 17:00 UTC for
INR 600,000, payable on 2027-02-28 at 17:00 UTC against invoice WILLOW-AX7-2027. This is a
separate procurement from order SO-AX7 and does not amend or waive any restriction in C03. No Forge
waiver or Willow release is attached.
4 PILOT FUNDING

4.1 Aurora shall pay Willow INR 80,000 for PROJECT-HABITAT by 2027-02-05 at 17:00 UTC against
invoice HABITAT-2027. No late charge or unspecified pilot-project damages are agreed.
C08 | Smart Building Partnership Page 1
WILLOW HOUSING / C08
5 WILLOW DEPLOYMENT PLAN

5.1 Willow shall deliver an approved deployment plan for PROJECT-HABITAT by 2027-02-03 at 17:00
UTC. Approval requires an Aurora signed approval record identifying the plan. A submitted but
unapproved draft is insufficient. No plan is assumed from the passage of time.
6 NO AMENDMENT OR REPLACEMENT

6.1 C08 neither amends nor replaces any part of C04, C05 or C02 and does not offset service credits or
combine invoices. APP-ATLAS maintenance and service-credit obligations remain exactly as stated in
C02. This agreement contains no commitment to change C01.
7 DISPUTES AND JOINT CLAIMS

7.1 Indian law governs. Mumbai courts have exclusive jurisdiction over claims solely under C08. Any
combined proceeding involving C04 also requires a separately signed forum agreement under clause 8.1
of C04 and this clause. The parties have not supplied that agreement. Do not assume one forum
automatically controls all claims.
8 TERMINATION AND SURVIVAL

8.1 Written breach notice to the other party legal email gives 10 calendar days after receipt to cure,
through 17:00 UTC on the tenth following date. Thereafter an uncured breach permits a separate
termination notice. Accrued payment obligations survive termination.
9 NOTICES

9.1 Aurora legal email is aurora-legal@aurora.example and Willow legal email is
legal@willow.example. A notice takes effect on proven receipt. A C08 notice does not by itself terminate
C02.
10 TIME AND ACCOUNTING

10.1 All times UTC and days calendar days, without holiday adjustments. Date-only deadlines end
at 17:00 UTC. All amounts exclude taxes. Independent scope does not imply the absence of all business
risk; assess each agreement on its evidence.
11 FRAMEWORK RISK ALLOCATION

11.1 Ordinary aggregate damages under this framework are capped at INR 1,000,000, except fraud,
wilful misconduct and indemnity obligations. The controller purchase price in clause 3.1 is a payment
commitment, not an additional fixed damages charge. No limit from another agreement is imported.
C08 | Smart Building Partnership Page 2
WILLOW HOUSING / C08
12 PARTICIPANT INDEMNITIES

12.1 A participant shall hold the other protected against third-party claims and reasonable defense costs
arising from its own infringement or unauthorized disclosure. The benefiting participant shall notify
promptly and cooperate reasonably in the defense.
13 PROJECT CONFIDENCE

13.1 Pilot plans, property drawings and non-public procurement terms shall remain within the authorized
project teams. Each party must prevent unrelated use and bind recipients to confidentiality. Apart from
material public without breach, these protections last 3 years after the framework ends.
14 PROJECT COMPLIANCE

14.1 Each party must comply with laws applicable to its role in pilot and controller procurement. This
includes the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable and GDPR where its processing
scope applies. Personal-data processing requires access controls and a documented incident-response
procedure. No ISO certification is promised.
15 CHANGE OF PARTICIPANT

15.1 A participant may assign the framework only with written consent. An affiliate assignment is
permissible on 30 calendar days written notice if the original participant remains liable. Corporate
restructuring alone neither replaces a party nor waives consent.
16 PROJECT IMPEDIMENTS

16.1 Relief for an event beyond reasonable control is confined to the affected obligations in pilot and
controller procurement. The affected party must give written notice within 5 calendar days after
discovery, explain causation and provide mitigation evidence. Accrued payments remain payable.
Neither an outage nor supplier delay qualifies automatically.
17 OTHER PARTNERSHIPS

17.1 The parties remain free to enter other arrangements outside the scope of pilot and controller
procurement. This agreement grants no exclusivity or non-compete except any restriction expressly
stated in this clause.
18 ORDINARY PROJECT WITHDRAWAL

18.1 Either party may end future pilot and controller procurement for convenience by written notice
received at the other party legal notice address at least 30 calendar days before termination. Accrued
payment obligations, express survival provisions and the stated conditions of any early-exit fee continue
to apply.
C08 | Smart Building Partnership Page 3
WILLOW HOUSING / C08
19 CONVENIENCE NOTICE PERIOD

19.1 For termination for convenience under clause 18.1, either party must give 60 calendar days prior
written notice. Clause 18.1 states 30 calendar days for the same notice. Both provisions form part of this
agreement and no order of precedence between them is stated.
20 FRAMEWORK EXECUTION

1.1 Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Owner) hires backup nodes EQ-DR01 and EQ-DR02 to Aurora

1.2 Aurora shall keep the nodes at UNIT-5, exercise reasonable care and neither sell nor pledge them. Forge

2 HIRE ACCOUNT

2.1 Possession begins on 2027-01-04 and ends on 2027-06-30. There is no automatic extension. Rent is
INR 30,000 monthly, due on day 10 at 17:00 UTC against HIRE-YYYY-MM. No deposit or payment interest is
stipulated.

2.2 The monthly sum includes ordinary maintenance of both nodes. An additional equipment charge cannot be
inferred from the C14 service fee, which belongs to a separate agreement.
3 HAND-BACK PROCEDURE

3.1 Both nodes must be physically received at Forge depot DEPOT-F by 2027-06-30 at 17:00 UTC. Dispatch does
not constitute return. The receipt must identify both asset IDs.

Aurora owes INR 2,000 in total, not per node. The hand-back charge is capped at INR 20,000. A later return on that
date does not reverse its charge.

caused by its own materials; fraud and those indemnities are outside the custody cap.

4.2 Configuration information is confidential for 2 years after return. Personal data on a node must be protected
under applicable data-protection law and erased before hand-back; a blank node alone is not proof of return.

5.1 A material breach may be ended after a written notice and 7 calendar days to cure. Aurora may end the hire for
convenience on 30 calendar days notice, but rent through actual return remains due.

mitigation; it does not erase accrued rent or automatically postpone hand-back. Indian law applies and Bengaluru
courts have exclusive jurisdiction. Calendar days and UTC govern all deadlines.

APP-ATLAS under C02.

monthly fee and due on 2027-02-05. No late-payment interest is specified; taxes are excluded.

3.1 The target availability is 99.5 percent per UTC calendar month. Calculate availability as 100 multiplied
by (calendar minutes minus unavailable minutes) divided by calendar minutes. Include every minute of the
month and all observed unavailability; no maintenance exclusion applies. The first scored month is
February 2027; the initial partial billing month is not measured for availability.

supports the monthly measurement. A recovery exercise or an outage on another application is not such a
report.

fee. At exactly 99.5 percent no credit is due. Only one percentage credit applies for the month, capped at
INR 15,000.

4.2 A claim must be received at aurora-legal@aurora.example by 17:00 UTC on the tenth calendar date
following the month final date. Show an eligible credit separately until a claim is established. The credit is
the sole monetary remedy for the measured availability shortfall.

5.1 Willow remains Controller and Aurora Processor for DS-HOUSING under C07. This service order does
not change those roles or treat every service interruption as an unauthorized disclosure. Each party shall
restrict access to resident information and comply with applicable privacy law.

received 45 calendar days before expiry, at 17:00 UTC on that date. Either party may terminate for material
breach after written notice and a 10-day cure opportunity; convenience termination requires 60 days notice.

7.1 Other contractual damages are limited to INR 720,000, excluding fraud and each party indemnity for its

majeure may excuse affected future performance after notice and mitigation but not accrued payments.

1 PROJECT BOUNDARY

1.1 Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Integrator) shall integrate the AX-7 controller interface for
Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Client) as project INT-AX7. Hardware procurement under C03
and the firmware tool license C06 retain their separate scope. This statement of work takes effect

2.1 Milestone M1 is the controller-interface prototype, scheduled for demonstration by 2027-01-31.
2.1.1 M1 evidence comprises source code, interface test results and the demonstration record.

by 2027-02-28. Total project consideration is INR 1,200,000, allocated equally between M1 and M2.

3.1 A milestone is accepted only when Anil Das for Forge signs a record identifying INT-AX7 and that
milestone. An unsigned record, a demonstration alone or silence does not establish acceptance.

3.2 For each accepted milestone Forge owes INR 600,000 by 17:00 UTC on the fifteenth calendar date
after both signed acceptance and receipt of its invoice. No payment becomes due from an invoice alone
and no late-payment interest is specified.
4 CHANGE CONTROL AND DELAY

4.1 A change to deliverables, dates or price requires a written change order signed by both parties. A
request to change scope is not an agreed amendment. Aurora shall identify effects on other obligations
rather than assuming they are waived.

4.2 If the M1 demonstration has not been delivered by 2027-01-31 at 17:00 UTC, Aurora owes Forge
INR 1,500 for each started UTC calendar date from 2027-02-01 on which the demonstration remains
undelivered at 00:00 UTC, capped at INR 30,000. Missing acceptance alone does not prove the
demonstration was late.
5 RIGHTS IN THE WORK

5.1 Forge receives the completed project deliverables after payment of the relevant milestone. Each party
retains its pre-existing tools and indemnifies the other against third-party infringement caused by
materials it supplies. TOOL-CIRCUIT is not transferred merely because it was used to develop a
deliverable.
6 PROJECT SAFEGUARDS

6.1 Designs, code and test data shall remain confidential for 3 years. Personnel must follow applicable
security and privacy requirements. Ordinary project damages are limited to INR 1,200,000, except fraud,
wilful misconduct and the infringement indemnities.
7 EXIT AND DISPUTE HANDLING

7.1 Either party may terminate an uncured material breach after written notice and 15 calendar days to
cure. Convenience termination needs 30 days notice; only accepted milestones and separately agreed
cancellation costs are payable. No unspecified cancellation fee is implied.

7.2 Assignment needs consent. Force majeure requires notice, evidence and mitigation and does not
excuse accrued sums. The parties shall first seek executive resolution for 15 days; Bengaluru courts then
have exclusive jurisdiction under Indian law.

1.1 Forge Electronics Private Limited (P02, Warrantor) gives Aurora Software Private Limited (P01, Buyer)
this undertaking for the AX-7 controllers supplied under PO-AX7 and C03. Each claim must identify a
covered serial number and its original conforming acceptance date.
2 COVERAGE

2.1 Manufacturing defects arising in normal use are covered for 12 calendar months from the original
acceptance date. Physical misuse, unauthorized modification and ordinary wear are excluded only when
supported by evidence. A replacement does not reset the original warranty period.
3 CLAIM AND REPLACEMENT

3.1 A claim received at notices@forge.example must identify its claim ID, serial number, acceptance record
and defect evidence. A complete claim within coverage starts the replacement process.

3.2 Forge shall deliver a conforming replacement by 17:00 UTC on the tenth calendar date following receipt
of a valid claim. Receipt at the exact deadline is timely; dispatch is not delivery.

3.3 For each started UTC calendar date after the replacement due date when the replacement remains
undelivered at 00:00 UTC, Forge owes Aurora INR 1,000, capped at INR 10,000 per claim. These charges
do not extinguish the replacement duty. No full purchase-price refund follows automatically from a delay.
4 TRANSPORT AND INFORMATION

4.1 Forge bears reasonable return transport for an accepted covered claim. Aurora shall remove data and
protect credentials before return. Technical claim records are confidential for 2 years, subject to mandatory
legal disclosure and applicable privacy law.

5 PRICE ALLOCATION

5.1 Warranty coverage is included in the price under C03. This undertaking creates no separate warranty
subscription fee and does not add another INR 500,000 to that purchase.
6 REMEDIES AND FORUM

6.1 Ordinary warranty damages are capped at INR 250,000, excluding fraud and each party indemnity for
third-party claims caused by its own infringement. No damages amount follows from that cap alone. Indian
law and Bengaluru courts govern warranty disputes independently of a downstream resale.
7 CONTINUING RIGHTS

7.1 The undertaking operates from 2027-01-14 through 2027-12-20 without auto-renewal. Coverage already
earned by original acceptance survives until its own expiry. Material breach allows termination of future
obligations after 10 calendar days written cure notice, without extinguishing earned coverage.

7.2 Neither party may assign this undertaking without consent. Force majeure relief requires proof, notice
and mitigation and does not automatically defeat a replacement claim. There is no exclusivity beyond any
separate express procurement promise.

aurora-legal@aurora.example. All dates use calendar days and UTC.
